name: neural plate
definition: Portion of tissue that is the earliest recognizable dorsal ectodermal primordium of the central nervous system present near the end of gastrulation before infolding to form the neural keel; consists of a thickened pseudostratified epithelium.
overrideNote: Handoff neural_plate_keel: the plate hands off to the neural keel over 10 to 11 hpf (D9), so the record ends at 11 hpf; ZFA ends the neural plate at 5-9 somites (14 hpf).

events.text: Presumptive neural plate specified in the dorsal ectoderm (ZFA presumptive neural plate starts at sphere).
Neural plate recognizable as a thickened dorsal ectoderm (ZFIN start, 75%-epiboly).
Convergence toward the dorsal midline starts; the plate folds into the neural keel (Araya et al. 2016 Dev Dyn 245:197-208 https://anatomypubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/dvdy.24304).
Plate no longer present as a separate structure (ZFIN end, 5-9 somites).

10 hpf: width 250 um, thickness 30 um (research 03b size row, estimate; Araya et al. 2016)
11 hpf: the plate narrows as it converges into the keel (handoff neural_plate_keel, D9); r0 110 um

name: neural keel
definition: An intermediate stage (between the neural plate and neural rod) during the early segmentation period in the morphogenesis of the central nervous system primordium; the keel is roughly triangular shaped in cross section.
overrideNote: Handoff neural_plate_keel: seeded from the neural plate at the window start 10 hpf (D9), which equals the ZFA start. Handoff neural_keel_rod: the keel hands off to the neural rod over 11.7 to 13 hpf (D9), so the record ends at 13 hpf; ZFA ends the keel at 10-13 somites (16 hpf).

events.text: Neural keel forms by convergence of the neural plate (ZFIN start, bud).
Brain primordium thickened into the keel; optic primordium first distinguishable in side view (https://zfin.org/zf_info/zfbook/stages/seg_stgs.html).
Keel rounds into the neural rod; three pronounced anterior thickenings visible (https://zfin.org/zf_info/zfbook/stages/seg_stgs.html).
Keel stage over (ZFIN end, 10-13 somites).

name: neural rod
definition: An intermediate stage in the development of the central nervous system present during the segmentation period; the neural rod is roughly cylindrical in shape, forms from the neural keel, and is not yet hollowed out into the neural tube.
overrideNote: Handoff neural_keel_rod: seeded from the neural keel at 11.66 hpf, the ZFA start, which precedes the window start 11.7 hpf (DM-33). Handoff neural_rod_tube: the rod hands off to the neural tube over 14 to 16 hpf (D9), so the record ends at 16 hpf; ZFA ends the rod at 14-19 somites (19 hpf).

events.text: Neural rod forms from the keel (ZFIN start, 5-9 somites).
About ten neuromeres visible along the rod; rhombomeres r2 to r6 visible dorsolaterally (https://zfin.org/zf_info/zfbook/stages/seg_stgs.html).
Neural tube closure; brain morphogenesis begins (Lowery & Sive 2005 Development 132:2057-2067 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15788456/).
Rod hollows into the neural tube (ZFIN end, 14-19 somites).

name: neural tube
definition: Portion of tissue that is the cavity-containing primordium of the central nervous system, developing from the neural rod in the late segmentation period.
overrideNote: Handoff neural_rod_tube: seeded from the neural rod at the window start 14 hpf (D9), which equals the ZFA start. Handoff neural_tube_brain: the tube hands off to the brain regions and the spinal cord over 22 to 24 hpf (D9), so the mesh and the record end at 24 hpf; ZFA ends the neural tube at Prim-5 (30 hpf). From 14 hpf the mesh spans only the trunk behind the hindbrain (spec BG-49): the four brain regions draw the head part.

events.text: Neural tube stage begins (ZFA start, 10-13 somites).
Brain ventricle inflation begins.
events.source: Gutzman and Sive 2012 J Vis Exp https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23128341/

events.text: Hollowing of the rod into the tube nearly complete; ventricles present along the brain.
Cerebrospinal fluid starts to fill the ventricles.
The tube hands off to the brain regions and the spinal cord (D9 neural_tube_brain).

name: telencephalon
definition: The anterior and dorsal forebrain neuromere. In ray-finned fishes and most pronounced in teleosts the roof plate of the embryonic telencephalon extends laterally with the effect that the paired alar plates forming the hemispheric walls roll out lateroventrally in a process called eversion. This is unlike the development in other vertebrate groups. From Neuroanatomy of the Zebrafish Brain.
overrideNote: Handoff neural_tube_brain: the region keeps its ZFA start of 14 hpf and is seeded from the neural tube as a sub-tube at 14 hpf (DM-33, spec BG-49); the window 22 to 24 hpf retires the tube mesh. DM-36: axis clamp at 4320 hpf.

events.text: Presumptive telencephalon (ZFA, 1-4 somites).
Telencephalon distinguishable (ZFIN start, 10-13 somites).
Telencephalon is one of four prominent brain subdivisions (https://zfin.org/zf_info/zfbook/stages/seg_stgs.html).
Eversion of the telencephalic roof starts; hemispheres become visible (ZFA definition; timing unverified).
Adult everted pallium with dorsal, medial, lateral and central zones (Wullimann, Rupp & Reichert 1996 Neuroanatomy of the Zebrafish Brain (Birkhauser)).

Phase 2 visual calibration (RN-01 to RN-04): the five brain lobes are placed as one continuous chain along the head, each ellipsoid overlapping its neighbours in u, so the central nervous system reads as one translucent mass with gentle bulges instead of separate spheres. The half-heights follow the local dorsal half-height times a brain factor that falls from 0.50 at 14 hpf to 0.29 in the adult; the sourced sizes above set that factor.

Phase 2 visual calibration: keyframes that crossed the body outline after the layout pass were seated toward the spine in steps of 1.5 percent, and shrunk in steps of 3 percent only when seating alone did not close the gap, until every vertex builds inside the skin.

name: diencephalon
definition: The more posterior and ventral of two forebrain neuromeres, the other being the telencephalon; major derivatives are the eye cups, the brain pretectal region, the thalamus, hypothalamus, and epithalamus (including the habenula and epiphysis).
overrideNote: Handoff neural_tube_brain: the region keeps its ZFA start of 14 hpf and is seeded from the neural tube as a sub-tube at 14 hpf (DM-33, spec BG-49); the window 22 to 24 hpf retires the tube mesh. DM-36: axis clamp at 4320 hpf.

Mid-diencephalic organizer active (ZFA, prim-5).

name: hypothalamus
definition: Multi-tissue structure which is the largest portion of diencephalon and is ventrally located. The hypothalamus arises near the end of the segmentation period and the embryonic hypothalamic region gives rise to the neurohypophysis and other diencephalic nuclei.

name: hypophysis
definition: A compound organ which is an endocrine gland located ventral to the diencephalon and derived from mixed neuroectodermal and non-neuroectodermal origin.

events.text: Hypophysis term starts (ZFIN, 20-25 somites); placode cells at the anterior neural ridge.

Adenohypophysis term starts (ZFA); hypophyseal capillary forms.
Neurohypophysis distinct (Chapman et al. 2005 J Comp Neurol 487:428-440 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15906316/).

name: epiphysis
definition: A circumscribed swelling, includes the pineal primordium that appears late in the segmentation period in the dorsal midline of the diencephalon. It is located directly rostral to the posterior commissure and dorsal to the habenular commissure.

events.text: Epiphysis term starts (ZFIN, 10-13 somites); epiphyseal cluster from 16 hpf.
Epiphysis rudiment visible (https://zfin.org/zf_info/zfbook/stages/seg_stgs.html).
About 30 pineal complex cells; anterior cells give rise to the parapineal (Snelson et al. 2008 Dev Dyn 237:3538-3544 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18629869/).
Parapineal migrates to the left between 24 and 32 hpf; ablation at 24 to 28 hpf gives symmetric habenulae (Lekk et al. 2019 eLife 8:e47376 https://elifesciences.org/articles/47376).
Epiphyseal stalk elongates (ZFA, 45-89 dpf).

name: optic tectum
definition: Multi-tissue structure that is the dorsal part of the midbrain and develops from the alar plate and is the most complex layered structure in the zebrafish brain.

events.text: Optic tectum term starts (ZFIN, prim-5).
First visual behaviors 68 to 80 hpf rely on retinotectal input (Easter & Nicola 1996 Dev Biol 180:646-663 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8954734/).
Tectum supports prey capture at 5 dpf; layered neuropil present (Bae et al. 2009 Dev Biol 330:406-426 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19371731/ for layering context).

ZFA calls the midbrain hindbrain boundary an anatomical line (is_a ZFA:0001689), so the record draws a collar around the neural tube and not a solid region: an open tube (caps none) over u 0.181 to 0.197 at v 0.36, between the midbrain centre (v 0.32) and the hindbrain path (v 0.38).

The radius is 0.80 of the anterior radius of the hindbrain record to 24 hpf and of the medulla oblongata record after it, with the hindbrain ellipticity 0.92. The collar is now narrower than both neighbours, so the brain outline runs tectum crown, waist, hindbrain and the isthmic constriction reads on screen: at 24 hpf the crown of the midbrain is 1.11 hindbrain radii and the collar 0.80, a waist of about a quarter. Kimmel 1995 names the constriction a landmark of the 14-19 somite stage, which is the ZFA start of this term; the earlier 0.95 collar filled the dip and hid it (review BIO-11).

The midbrain ellipsoid has tapered to 0.84 of the hindbrain radius by u 0.187 while the hindbrain tube starts only at u 0.19, so the midbrain taper, not the collar, sets the deepest part of the waist; a collar below 0.84 changes nothing more.

The u range and the 0.80 factor are estimates read off the midbrain and hindbrain records of this file, not measurements; the ratio of the midbrain radii to the hindbrain radius is the same at every keyframe, so one factor holds from 16 hpf to 4320 hpf.

name: hindbrain
definition: The most posterior of the three principal regions of the brain. In mammals and birds the hindbrain is divided into a rostral metencephalon and a caudal myelencephalon. In zebrafish, with the exception of the cerebellum, the ventral remainder of the metencephalon can be separated only arbitrarily from the more caudal myelencephalic portion of the medulla oblongata and thus these are not distinguished here. From Neuroanatomy of the Zebrafish Brain.
overrideNote: Handoff neural_tube_brain: the region keeps its ZFA start of 14 hpf and is seeded from the neural tube as a sub-tube at 14 hpf (DM-33, spec BG-49); the window 22 to 24 hpf retires the tube mesh. DM-36: axis clamp at 4320 hpf. The hindbrain mesh ends at 24 hpf (geometryEndHpf): from 24 hpf the medulla oblongata and the cerebellum draw its volume and the rhombomere array its surface (research 03b: five lobes at 24 hpf, phar.html).

name: cerebellum
definition: Brain structure derived from the anterior hindbrain, and perhaps including posterior midbrain. The cerebellum plays a role in somatic motor function, the control of muscle tone, and balance. In zebrafish, with the exception of the cerebellum, the ventral remainder of the metencephalon can be separated only arbitrarily from the more caudal myelencephalic portion of the medulla oblongata and thus these are not distinguished here.

name: floor plate
definition: Multi-tissue structure that is the ventral-most aspect of the developing neural tube. The floor plate is a specialized glial structure with secretory function that spans the rostral-caudal axis from the midbrain to the tail regions. The floor plate is one of first structures that differentiate in the developing nervous system.
